clips.display_text: Here is the complete replication fork: helicase unwinding at the front, SSBs holding the strands open, polymerase synthesizing the leading strand continuously, polymerase building Okazaki fragments on the lagging strand, and ligase sealing them behind. This asymmetry is a direct consequence of the antiparallel structure you saw earlier.
